newsitem.title: USA: Hilcoast in merger deal to go private.
newsitem.headline: Hilcoast in merger deal to go private.

text.p: Hilcoast Development Corp said on Monday it entered into a merger agreement with a new acquisition company formed by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer H. Irwin Levy, for $6 per Hilcoast share in cash.
In August, Hilcoast said it formed a special independent committee of directors to study Levy's unsolicited proposal to buy the company for $6 per share.
Hilcoast said its board and the committee approved the terms and recommended shareholders adopt it. The company said the proposed merger was subject to certain conditions.
